bio.text: George "Chip" Tangen, of Inver Grove Heights, is the Libertarian candidate for Minnesota secretary of state in 2026; his KAXE candidate survey response lists his employment as a relationship manager at Enterprise Minnesota.

In his KAXE candidate survey response, Tangen said he holds political science and law degrees from Middlebury College and the University of Minnesota and served as legislative counsel to U.S. Rep. Jim Ramstad.
